task-manager.description: Task Manager MCP Server - Direct task management in Claude Code

database.description: SQLite database for persistent task storage

usage.database: claude mcp add database -s project -- npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-sqlite --db-path ./tasks.db
usage.github: claude mcp add github -s user --env GITHUB_TOKEN=$GITHUB_TOKEN -- npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-github
usage.slack: claude mcp add slack -s project --env SLACK_TOKEN=$SLACK_TOKEN -- npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-slack
